scope: XMemSetAllocationHooks (ordinal 25) and callback routing for XMemAlloc/XMemFree. Single-threaded native comparison and guest tests; invalid callback invocation, allocator lifetime races and memory profiling callbacks are not validated.
native_method: Maps the supplied hash-verified PE in temporary memory, and calls the original three named routines with local callbacks. Synchronization and CFG dispatch pointers are replaced with single-thread control stubs. No console code is stored.
native_result: xmem-native-hooks PASS calls=2/2 zero-size=1 null-free=1 restore=1 partial-pair=1 reentrant=1
guest_result: Two allocation and free callbacks receive unmodified args, including zero-size allocation and null free. Null allocator restores both defaults. A reentrant callback resets the pair without deadlock.
limits: Console allocations with memory profiling enabled are not reproduced.
The real DLL stores a null free callback if a nonnull allocator is installed with null free; its subsequent invocation would fault. TuxBox reports ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER instead.
Callers must retain callback lifetime until all concurrent in-flight calls finish. Only the synchronization mechanism, not full concurrent behavior against the console, is tested.
The native control uses a mapped image with selected synchronization and CFG imports replaced; it is not a full console DLL initialization.
